info.title: Custom Scripts
info.description: This spec describes the permissible contents of a custom-scripts.json file in a documentation catalog, which is used to add custom scripts to a DocC-generated website.

Scripts.description: An array of custom scripts, which is the top-level container in a custom-scripts.json file.

Script.description: An abstract schema representing any script, from which both script types inherit.

type.description: The `type` attribute of the HTML script element.

run.description: Whether the custom script should be run only on the initial page load, each time the reader navigates after the initial page load, or both.

ExternalScript.description: A script at an external URL.

LocalScript.description: A script from a local file.

name.description: The name of the local script file, optionally including the '.js' extension.
